name: IntPhys 2
summary: 通过可能与不可能事件检验物体持续性、连续性、固体性和不变性。
summaryEn: Possible and impossible event videos test object persistence, continuity, solidity and immutability.
scale: 1,012 main-set videos; 60 debug and 344 held-out videos
scaleZh: 主集 1,012 段视频；另有 60 段调试和 344 段保留集视频
access: Official documentation provides data access instructions; download not tested
accessZh: 官方文档提供数据访问说明；未实测下载
license: CC BY-NC 4.0 with additional evaluation-only and no-generative-use restrictions
licenseZh: CC BY-NC 4.0，并附仅限评测、禁止生成用途的额外限制
wmNote: 保留集不发布完整元数据；原生任务是物理合理性评测。
wmNoteEn: Held-out metadata are withheld; the native task evaluates physical plausibility.

evidence.statement: Controlled possible/impossible event videos test violations of four physical principles, with loaders and evaluation code for prediction-based models. The released split table separates debug, main and held-out sets.
